newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Cricket expected to upstage stocks in Colombo.
newsitem.headline: Cricket expected to upstage stocks in Colombo.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were expected to open little changed on Thursday as most retail investors in this cricket-crazy country turned their attention to a test match versus rival India.
On Tuesday, the all share index closed 6.8 points higher at 862.5 on local buying of blue chips. Turnover was 117.18 million rupees.

"Retail investors, the ones who really move the market, will be watching Sanath Jayasuriya try to break another world record," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena of Ceylinco Stock Brokers. Jayasuriya who was on 326 not out in the first test against India on Tuesday, is expected to try to better West Indian Brian Lara's record of 375 runs.-- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
